description: This source file contains JNI (Java Native Interface) code for managing EGL (OpenGL ES) display, context, and surface objects in Android. It includes class initialization, handle conversion functions, and static references to EGL objects and methods.

methods.name: nativeClassInit
methods.description: Initializes static references to EGL-related Java classes and methods, and sets up default EGL object references.

methods.name: fromEGLHandle
methods.description: Converts a Java EGL object to its native handle (pointer).

methods.name: toEGLHandle
methods.description: Creates a Java EGL object from a native handle, returning special objects for EGL_NO_CONTEXT, EGL_NO_DISPLAY, and EGL_NO_SURFACE.
